If the reference conflicts with the supplied evidence, flag human review rather than silently repairing it. Return JSON satisfying the provided schema; provide brief reasons and only exact, nonempty quotations from the response as evidence. Evidence lists may be empty when the judgement concerns an omission. No chain-of-thought is requested.
